speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four hours and a little. I am not giving you the middle of it. We are here.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Here is the work. Three to a bed. You, and I, and George. A fourth man can find the next bed without a speech.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I have slept in worse state. The dry room is for the paper, not for my importance. The chest goes there, and the chest does not share a bed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The baskets where a man need not climb. Say the place once.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Ground floor. Left of the passage. If a man climbs for a roll, he was not listening.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The boys are with me. Nick, Sam, and Arthur. I can see their door from this room, and I mean to see it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nick does not sing tonight. Your order has held. This inn is not where it changes.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: It does not change here. If he sings tomorrow he sings the lowest and the fewest. Tonight he sleeps. He has not answered me with a note, which is what I asked of him.

speaker: george_bryan
text: If this room has a hanging, it is the inn's. We do not touch it. A strange town is allowed to look at players. Let it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let it look. I want the paper dry and three boys accounted. I do not want a supper made into a council.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Supper is the inn's. I have put my hand on the oiled cloth. It is dry. I am not reading a figure aloud in a passage.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not. Nine shillings are in my purse for the small things. The rest is locked at home, and that figure stays at home.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Good. A purse in a doorway becomes a talk. We have had the talk. Scarlet stays downstairs in the basket. Nobody borrows a yeoman's colour to cross the yard.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Boys inside before the dark is full. I will count three heads. I will not count their voices. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. I am at the window a minute. Then I am one of the three.

speaker: john_heminges
text: God keep you. The meadow can stay white without a further report.
